metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: After her father's sudden death, sheltered teenager Carrie White, raised by her domineering mother, enters public high school, where she faces a viral bullying scandal and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers.

metas.name: Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

metas.name: American Horror Story
metas.description: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, showcasing different aspects of horror. Created and produced by Ryan Murphy and Brad Falchuk.

metas.name: Widow's Bay
metas.description: A skeptical mayor leads the superstitious residents of a cursed New England island.

metas.name: Haunted Hotel
metas.description: A single mom with two kids operates a haunted hotel, aided by her late brother's ghost who believes they can have ingenious ideas despite his ethereal state.

metas.name: Supernatural
metas.description: Two brothers follow their father's footsteps as hunters, fighting evil supernatural beings of many kinds, including monsters, demons, and gods that roam the earth.

metas.name: The Walking Dead
metas.description: Sheriff Deputy Rick Grimes wakes up from a coma to learn the world is in ruins and must lead a group of survivors to stay alive.

metas.name: Stranger Things
metas.description: In 1980s Indiana, a group of young friends witness supernatural forces and secret government exploits. As they search for answers, the children unravel a series of extraordinary mysteries.

metas.name: The Haunting of Hill House
metas.description: Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it.

metas.name: From
metas.description: A town with a hidden secret experiences strange occurrences that intensify at night. Mysterious forces disrupt everyday routines as residents try to preserve stability and community while attempting to comprehend their surroundings.

metas.name: Midnight Mass
metas.description: An isolated island community experiences miraculous events - and frightening omens - after the arrival of a charismatic, mysterious young priest.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

metas.name: The Vampire Diaries
metas.description: The lives, loves, dangers and disasters in the town, Mystic Falls, Virginia. Creatures of unspeakable horror lurk beneath this town as a teenage girl is suddenly torn between two vampire brothers.

metas.name: It: Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

metas.name: The Watcher
metas.description: A married couple moving into their dream home are threatened by terrifying letters from a stalker, signed - "The Watcher.".

metas.name: The Terror
metas.description: Supernatural, semihistorical horror anthology series, where each season is inspired by a different infamous or mysterious real-life historical tragedy.

metas.name: Yellowjackets
metas.description: A wildly talented girls' high school soccer team become the unlucky survivors of a plane crash deep in the Canadian wilderness.

metas.name: The Haunting of Bly Manor
metas.description: After an au pair’s tragic death, Henry hires a young American nanny to care for his orphaned niece and nephew who reside at Bly Manor with the chef Owen, groundskeeper Jamie and housekeeper, Mrs. Grose.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A look into the nightly lives of four vampires who have lived together on Staten Island for over a century.

metas.name: The Twilight Zone
metas.description: Ordinary people face uncanny and impossible events in standalone tales of science fiction, fantasy, horror, and suspense.

metas.name: The Fall of the House of Usher
metas.description: Siblings Roderick and Madeline Usher have built a pharmaceutical company into an empire of wealth, privilege and power; however, secrets come to light when the heirs to the Usher dynasty start dying.

metas.name: The Midnight Club
metas.description: At a hospice for terminally ill young adults, eight patients come together every night at midnight to tell each other stories - and make a pact that the next of them to die will give the group a sign from the beyond.

metas.name: The Outsider
metas.description: When an insidious supernatural force edges its way into a seemingly straightforward investigation into the gruesome murder of a young boy, it leads a seasoned cop and an unorthodox investigator to question everything they believe in.

metas.name: Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
metas.description: A certain atmosphere of horror is felt the week before the celebration of an unfortunate wedding.

metas.name: The Originals
metas.description: A family of power-hungry thousand-year-old vampires look to take back the city that they built and dominate all those who have done them wrong.

metas.name: Evil
metas.description: A skeptical psychologist and scientist join a Catholic priest-in-training to investigate the church's backlog of unexplained mysteries, miracles, and demonic possessions.

metas.name: The Sandman
metas.description: Upon escaping after decades of imprisonment by a mortal wizard, Dream, the personification of dreams, sets about to reclaim his lost equipment.

metas.name: Penny Dreadful
metas.description: Explorer Sir Malcolm Murray, American gunslinger Ethan Chandler, scientist Victor Frankenstein and medium Vanessa Ives unite to combat supernatural threats in Victorian London.

metas.name: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
metas.description: Daryl's journey across a broken but resilient France as he hopes to find a way back home.

metas.name: The Strain
metas.description: A mysterious viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism ravages the city of New York.

metas.name: Alice in Borderland
metas.description: Arisu - a listless, jobless and video-game-obsessed young man - suddenly finds himself in a strange, emptied-out version of Tokyo in which he and his friends must compete in dangerous games in order to survive.

metas.name: The Beauty
metas.description: Partners Cooper Madsen and Jordan Bennett investigate "the Beauty" STD causing aesthetic effects but proving lethal, evading corrupt officials and a mercenary targeting them amidst a suspected government conspiracy.

metas.name: Fear the Walking Dead
metas.description: A Walking Dead spinoff set in Los Angeles, California. Follows two families who must band together to survive the undead apocalypse.

metas.name: Castle Rock
metas.description: A psychological-horror series set in the Stephen King multiverse combines the mythological scale and intimate character storytelling, weaving an epic saga of darkness and light, played out on a few square miles of Maine woodland.

metas.name: The Exorcist
metas.description: Follows two priests dealing with cases of a demonic presence targeting a family and a foster home.

metas.name: Bates Motel
metas.description: An intimate look into the unraveling of Norman Bates' psyche throughout his teenage years.

metas.name: Scream Queens
metas.description: A semi-anthology series that centers on characters being terrorized by a serial killer in different locations, including a university and a hospital.

metas.name: Locke & Key
metas.description: After their father is murdered under mysterious circumstances, the three Locke siblings and their mother move into their ancestral home, Keyhouse, which they discover is full of magical keys that may be connected to their father's...

metas.name: American Horror Stories
metas.description: An anthology series of stand-alone episodes delving into horror myths, legends, and lore.

metas.name: The Following
metas.description: A brilliant, charismatic, and psychotic serial killer communicates with other active serial killers and activates a cult of believers who follow his every command.

metas.name: The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live
metas.description: The love story between Rick and Michonne. Changed by a world that is constantly changing, will they find themselves in a war against the living or will they discover that they too are The Walking Dead?

metas.name: Wayward Pines
metas.description: A Secret Service agent goes to Wayward Pines, Idaho, in search of two federal agents who have gone missing in the bucolic town. He soon learns that he might never get out of Wayward Pines alive.

metas.name: The Institute
metas.description: A teen genius wakes up in a strange place full of children who got there the same way he did, and who all, like him, possess unusual abilities.

metas.name: Servant
metas.description: A Philadelphia couple are in mourning after an unspeakable tragedy creates a rift in their marriage and opens a door for a mysterious force to enter their home.

metas.name: Ash vs Evil Dead
metas.description: Ash has spent the last thirty years avoiding responsibility, maturity, and the terrors of the Evil Dead until a Deadite plague threatens to destroy all of mankind and Ash becomes mankind's only hope.

metas.name: Guillermo del Toro's Cabinet of Curiosities
metas.description: Bizarre nightmares unfold in eight tales of terror in a visually stunning, spine-tingling horror collection curated by Guillermo del Toro.

metas.name: Based on a True Story
metas.description: A realtor, a former tennis star, and a plumber seize a unique opportunity to capitalize on America's obsession with true crime.

metas.name: Kingdom
metas.description: While strange rumors about their ill King grip a kingdom, the crown prince becomes their only hope against a mysterious plague overtaking the land.

metas.name: My Sad Dead
metas.description: A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.

metas.name: Them
metas.description: Anthology horror series with varying characters and locations by season, featuring different aspects of the horror genre.

metas.name: Archive 81
metas.description: An archivist hired to restore a collection of tapes finds himself reconstructing the work of a filmmaker and her investigation into a dangerous cult.

metas.name: Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: A beautiful detective falls in love with an ex-soldier who goes into hiding from the secret government organization that turned him into a mechanically charged beast.

metas.name: Chilling Romance
metas.description: An investigative occult romance drama about a hotel heiress who can see ghosts and a passionate prosecutor who team up in a chaotic partnership.

metas.name: Salem
metas.description: Supernatural horror loosely based on Salem's 17th century witch trials.

metas.name: Santa Clarita Diet
metas.description: Sheila and Joel are married real estate agents who live and work in Santa Clarita, California. When Sheila dies, their lives take a dark turn.

metas.name: Sweet Home
metas.description: A teenage outcast is uprooted from his residence and forced to confront terrifying monsters intent on eradicating humanity. As he battles against impossible odds, he discovers the strength to fight for survival and to protect others.

metas.name: If Wishes Could Kill
metas.description: Follows five friends in high school who receive a death warning from a mysterious wish-granting app. As they struggle to escape their fates, they uncover chilling truths that connect the app to the sudden death of a classmate.

metas.name: True Haunting
metas.description: Horror virtuoso James Wan applies his spine-tingling filmmaking style to authentic paranormal tales.

metas.name: The Summer Hikaru Died
metas.description: Hikaru vanishes, replaced by an entity with his appearance, voice, and memories. The mysterious being maintains Hikaru's persona, making distinguishing it from the real Hikaru challenging as they continue their daily routines.

metas.name: Cassandra
metas.description: Germany's oldest smart home awakens its AI helper Cassandra after decades when a new family moves in. Cassandra, determined never to be abandoned again, manipulates events using the home's resources to become part of the family.
